measurement_note: Size S is both nums.length and queries.length. Tiers 32, 128, and 512 span 16x; every query covers at least half the array and the repeated 23-value pattern exercises frequency and tie logic. The accepted block decomposition is O(S sqrt(S) log S); directly counting every queried range is correct O(S^2), completes every tier, and must fail only scaling.
